title: 配置优先级：命令行 > 环境变量 > profile > 通用配置
expected_output:
=== precedence: later sources override earlier ones ===
  1. default properties
  2. application.yml
  3. application-prod.yml (profile)
  4. OS env / -D system properties
  5. command line args

=== effective config (profile=prod) ===
  server.port                = 18080
  spring.datasource.url      = jdbc:mysql://prod-db:3306/app
  logging.level.root         = WARN
  app.name                   = demo-service

=== where each winning value came from ===
  server.port            <- command line (highest)
  logging.level.root     <- env / -D
  spring.datasource.url  <- application-prod.yml (profile wins over application.yml)
  app.name               <- application.yml (fell back: not overridden anywhere else)

=== profile=dev: unset profile key falls back to application.yml ===
  spring.datasource.url  = jdbc:h2:mem:test
  server.port            = 18080  (command line still wins)

profile keys present in prod-only layer : 1
key count in effective map              : 4
